messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool hyperion-enterprise-prod: GPU_util=98% (5m), queue=420, p99 latency spiking, error rate 3.2%. Started 2259990000. Autoscale attempts 3x failed.
oncall-amber: paging SRE oncall, taking ownership :rotating_light:
sre-dan: oncall Amber -- I'm on it. pulling pool metrics, logs now.
infra-raj: I can look at autoscaler logs if you want me to. any sign of quota/az issues?
sre-dan: autoscaler panicked on allocation: "insufficient capacity in region" repeated. looks like shared spare capacity exhausted for this tenant. queue backpressure causing retries.
account-ops-lena: Hyperion is an enterprise VPC customer with reserved dedicated pool. We have emergency burst credits configured but policy requires ops signoff >4 GPUs. Sam, can you confirm customer impact?
cust-liaison-sam: Reached out to Hyperion account team — they're seeing 503s in production and have alerting. Their pagers are tripped. They request immediate mitigation; told them we're investigating.
sre-dan: TL;DR: single tenant (hyperion) is saturating their dedicated pool due to a sudden traffic spike from a scheduled batch job that misfired. Autoscaler tried to allocate spare nodes in the region but AWS returned capacity errors. We can either: (A) approve emergency burst into partner pool (if infra allows) or (B) evict or throttle low-priority jobs within the tenant.
eng-prod-ivy: FYI hyperion's job is latency-sensitive inference. Throttling will cause visible errors to their customers. If we can get a small burst (2-4 gpus) it should stabilize for ~30m while they rollback.
account-ops-lena: Approving emergency burst requires signoff from me + billing + infra. Cost delta estimate: ~$12k/hr for 8 GPUs extra. For 4 GPUs it's ~$6k/hr.
infra-raj: I can request a cross-pool allocation from spare capacity now. Need approval to run an emergency override to bypass quota guard for up to 4 GPUs. Command: `rbctl pool override --pool hyperion-enterprise-prod --add-gpus 4 --reason "incident: emergency burst"`
oncall-amber: Lena, Sam — please confirm we can do the 4 GPU burst. Need verbal signoff here to proceed.
account-ops-lena: I approve 4 GPU burst. Billing acknowledged potential overage, will flag with finance.
cust-liaison-sam: Hyperion consents to emergency burst, they will pause the batch job as well.
infra-raj: executing override now...
infra-raj: `rbctl pool override` returned OK. New capacity showing +4 GPUs, queue dropping.
sre-dan: Seeing queue drop: 420 -> 110 in 2m, p99 latency decreasing. Error rate down to 0.7%. :white_check_mark:
eng-prod-ivy: Confirmed traffic back to app-level healthy for key endpoints. Hyperion team says errors gone.
oncall-amber: Good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. Please leave notes for postmortem: why autoscaler couldn't procure capacity and whether we need regional spare improvements.
sre-dan: Will collect logs and autoscaler traces. Action items: (1) postmortem + RCA owner (Dan), (2) infra to evaluate spare capacity policy (Raj), (3) account ops to review burst billing limits (Lena), (4) product to discuss better safety controls on scheduled jobs (Ivy).
account-ops-lena: Notifying finance and recording emergency approval.
cust-liaison-sam: Notifying Hyperion ops lead that we performed emergency burst and that they should roll back batch. They acknowledged.
infra-raj: leaving a short runbook update: if region capacity errors >2 attempts, escalate to cross-pool override; add automation ticket.
oncall-amber: Thanks team. Marking incident resolved for paging. We'll update incident channel when RCA is published. :sound:
